pre-premium: Big hands want the biggest bet: 4x.
pre-king: Suited kings: always 4x. Offsuit kings: K5 and up.
pre-queen-jack: Queens: Q6 suited or Q8 offsuit and up. Jacks: J8 suited or JT offsuit and up.
pre-small-pair: Every pair from 33 up is 4x. Deuces: check.
pre-low: With a ten or lower as your top card, check (unless it's a pair).
flop-hidden-pair: A pair that uses your card: bet 2x.
flop-two-pair-plus: Two pair or better that uses your cards: bet 2x.
flop-board-pair: A pair on the board belongs to the dealer too: check.
flop-flush-draw: Four to a flush: 2x only with a ten or better of that suit in your hand.
flop-straight-draw: Straight draws: check, and bet 1x on the river if it comes.
flop-deuces: Pocket deuces with no third deuce: perfect play checks, even on a paired flop (the basic card's rule (a) says 2x on a paired board).
river-hidden-pair: Hidden pair or better: always bet 1x.
river-outs-low: Count the dealer's outs: fewer than 21, bet 1x; otherwise fold. Here: {outs}.
river-outs-edge: Count the dealer's outs: fewer than 21, bet 1x; otherwise fold. Here: {outs}.
river-outs-high: Count the dealer's outs: fewer than 21, bet 1x; otherwise fold. Here: {outs}.
river-board-plays: Your best five is the board, so you can tie but never win. Count the dealer's outs: the basic card says bet 1x with fewer than 21 and fold with 21 or more; perfect play folds from 19. Here: {outs}.
